title: Collations, macros and identifiers
description: DuckDB has collations (`NOCASE`, `NOACCENT`), macros that shadow functions, and case-insensitive identifiers.
reference: The replay skips queries under a collation or macro, and follows the identifiers.

provenance.notes: Recorded from the replay's translation of DuckDB's SQL to DataFusion's (`sverify_dev.slt.translate`).
